socialInbox.author: Prashant K.
socialInbox.text: Waited 40 minutes at the counter for a simple MCB order. Staff were polite but slow.

teamLog.text: Checked the filing calendar: TDS deducted in October is due on 7 November.
Prepared the morning digest and emailed it to Anil Kaveri.
Read bill SCPL/2611/554 from Sahyadri Cables Pvt Ltd, ₹25,31,364. Waiting for your approval before posting.
Read bill NSL/2611/876 from Narmada Switchgear Ltd, ₹12,65,285. Waiting for your approval before posting.
Passed @sparkline_electricals' enquiry on Instagram to the Sales Rep.
Read bill 05/2611/244 from Konkan Logistics Pvt Ltd, ₹17,228. Waiting for your approval before posting.
Filed a copy of invoice KE/26-27/0293 for Sahyog Infratech Ltd.
Filed a copy of invoice KE/26-27/0294 for Kale Constructions.
Filed a copy of invoice KE/26-27/0295 for Verma Traders.
Passed a WhatsApp enquiry for 50 MCBs to the Sales Rep. The free reply window closes tomorrow morning.
6 SKUs are at or below their reorder point. Drafted a purchase order for lighting stock.
Ran the morning ageing check and drafted reminders for overdue invoices.
Prepared the October GSTR-1 file from the books: ready for Mehta & Associates.
Compared the accountant's October drafts with the books. Found differences to review.
Drafted replies to 8 new comments, messages and reviews, including a 2-star review about counter waiting time.
Held back "Pedestal fans while stock lasts": the Instagram text changed after you approved the calendar.
Drafted quotation KE/Q/26-27/046 for Kale Constructions.
Flagged to the Quote Desk: Kale Constructions already has invoices more than 60 days overdue.
Qualified Sinhgad Engineering College: budget confirmed, decision expected by 20 November.
Pedestal fans and MCCBs have not moved in 60 days. Drafted a WhatsApp scheme to clear them.
X is limiting posts, so I stopped publishing there. Posts for X are ready to post by hand.
Sharma Traders paid part of an older invoice. Updated their ageing.
Matched 6 bank receipts to open invoices.
Followed up with Ostwal Realty on their quotation. They asked for a revised delivery schedule.
Scheduled "Wedding-season lighting" for Instagram, Facebook and Threads tomorrow.
Drafted the December calendar: 13 posts.
Received a document by email from billing@konkanlogistics.in. Reading it now.
